plugins.name: codebase-intelligence
plugins.description: Standalone PRP workflow — prp-plan / prp-implement / prp-loop — with Serena LSP structural codebase search, cross-session memory, Jira context injection, a personal KB (local FTS5 vault index), a bounded closed-loop runner with contract-mandated stop rules and an independent verifier, and prp-orchestrate: spec-driven agent teams that groom a Definition-of-Ready spec, audit the whole artifact chain before any code exists, freeze cross-lane contracts, ship one demoable checkpoint per user story, and gate the integrated branch (CI-parity + Copilot/bugbot parity + constitution) before any PR opens. The Obsidian vault is the system of record: run state, pre-pr-gate receipts, the cleanup ledger, plans, reports, session memory and every PR description are vault notes rather than repo-local files, and a failed vault write stops the phase instead of falling back to a copy no sibling worktree or later session can read. Every PR gets its title and body from pr-description automatically — `[TICKET] task description`, written to the vault before the PR is opened. Cross-cutting rules have one copy in shared/ and are cited, not restated, with a validator check that fails on an unresolved citation or a block re-inlined into three or more files. No prp-core required.
